# Markdown to Word

> Free, open-source tool that converts GitHub Flavored Markdown into formatted Word (.docx) documents — entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

Markdown to Word runs 100% client-side: Markdown is converted locally in the browser and never sent to any server. It's the reverse of [Word to Markdown](https://word2md.com/), by the same maker.

## Pages

- [Markdown to Word converter](https://md2word.app/): Drop or paste Markdown (including ChatGPT or Claude responses) and download a formatted `.docx`, or copy formatted text into Word or Google Docs.
- [Privacy](https://md2word.app/privacy/): How your data is handled — conversion is entirely client-side and nothing is uploaded.
- [Terms of Use](https://md2word.app/terms/): The terms governing use of the converter, provided as-is without warranty.

## About

- [Source code](https://github.com/benbalter/markdown-to-word-js): Open-source on GitHub.
- [Word to Markdown](https://word2md.com/): The sibling converter, Word (.docx) to Markdown.
- Author: [Ben Balter](https://ben.balter.com)
